name: Tonari no S Tsuma ~Ijimete Ageru♪~
source:
My parents were away on a one-week trip. I am alone at home, till the beautiful woman next door Motomura Keiko came to see after me. My parents asked her to take care of me during their absence. So, I started to live with her at my home for a week. Until then, I had never dreamed that she was such a slut...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029187.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的父母外出旅行一週了。我獨自在家，直到隔壁的美女本村惠子來看我。父母拜託她在他們不在期間照顧我。於是，我和她在我家一起生活了一週。在那之前，我從未想過她竟然如此放蕩……

［編輯自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029187.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
